description: Five bounded read-only Wikipedia tools guiding search to a compact lead, outline, one section, and controlled links

capabilities.description: Start here: find bounded Wikipedia page candidates, then pass one exact title to `wikipedia page --title` for a compact overview

cursor.description: Cursor returned by the preceding identical `wikipedia search`; do not edit it.

language.description: Active Wikipedia edition code from the provider's checked-in allowlist; defaults to en (for example: de, fr, simple, zh-min-nan).

limit.description: Maximum candidates from one API page.

query.description: Search phrase. Controls and insource: are rejected; no raw query passthrough.

capabilities.description: After search, read one compact canonical lead and identity; use `wikipedia outline` for detail instead of requesting a whole article

language.description: Active Wikipedia edition code from the provider's checked-in allowlist; defaults to en (for example: de, fr, simple, zh-min-nan).

max_chars.description: Maximum Unicode characters in the compact lead.

title.description: Exact title from `wikipedia search`; redirects resolve through Wikipedia only.

capabilities.description: List a page's bounded table of contents; choose one returned index and pass it unchanged to `wikipedia section --section-index`

language.description: Active Wikipedia edition code from the provider's checked-in allowlist; defaults to en (for example: de, fr, simple, zh-min-nan).

max_sections.description: Maximum outline entries; no continuation is drained.

title.description: Canonical or redirecting Wikipedia title from `wikipedia search` or `wikipedia page`.

capabilities.description: Retrieve exactly one bounded section selected from `wikipedia outline` and pinned to the resolved revision; never dumps a whole article

language.description: Active Wikipedia edition code from the provider's checked-in allowlist; defaults to en (for example: de, fr, simple, zh-min-nan).

max_chars.description: Maximum Unicode characters in the selected section plaintext.

section_index.description: Copy one index exactly from `wikipedia outline`; headings are not accepted as selectors.

title.description: The same title used for `wikipedia outline`.

capabilities.description: After reading a page, list one bounded page of main-namespace links for controlled follow-up; run `wikipedia search` or `wikipedia page` on selected links rather than spidering blindly

cursor.description: Cursor returned by the preceding identical `wikipedia links`; do not edit it.

language.description: Active Wikipedia edition code from the provider's checked-in allowlist; defaults to en (for example: de, fr, simple, zh-min-nan).

limit.description: Maximum main-namespace links from one API page.

title.description: Canonical or redirecting page whose article links should be listed.
